skills.name: create-maggy-theme
skills.description: Create a custom Maggy theme (JSON file) that recolors the agy statusline mascot, swaps sparkles, adds a side prop and picks the dates it shows. Use when a user wants their own Maggy look, e.g. for a holiday or team colors.

skills.name: install-maggy
skills.description: Install, verify, update or remove Maggy, the animated terminal pet and statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy), on macOS or Linux. Use when a user asks to set up Maggy or a custom agy statusline.
